observation.provenance: EgoEngine Section 3.2.2 publishes only the broad categories hand state, object pose, and retargeted reference command. The exact fields, anchor encoding, timestamps, contact flags, and one-step command preview below are local engineering choices and are not claimed as author settings.

residual_action.provenance: One controlled local repair of the diagnosed normalized-action unit mismatch. The existing +/-0.05 rad safety limit is retained; only the normalized output mapping changes. EgoEngine does not publish this residual scale.
